newsitem.title: UK: Texaco to send new Captain oil to UK Nigg Bay.
newsitem.headline: Texaco to send new Captain oil to UK Nigg Bay.

text.p: Texaco North Sea said it signed a contract with British Petroleum to bring ashore crude from Texaco's Captain oilfield to BP's Nigg Bay terminal in eastern Scotland.
Captain crude will be delivered to Nigg by shuttle tanker when the new field comes onstream early next year.

"The facility at Nigg will give us the flexibility to deliver to customers crude cargoes which are either larger or smaller than the shuttle tanker's capacity," said Captain Development Manager Shah Etebar. "It will also enable us to deliver the crude to customers in areas outside the tanker's range."
BP's operating interest in Nigg is being bought by Talisman Energy Inc, effective early next year.
Captain is expected to reach capacity at some 60,000 barrels a day (bpd) by the middle of next year.
